resources.string: Development build: Explore rooms with original lighting and fog, and jump through windows in r100/r101. Leon has infinite health in playtests. The full campaign is in development.
Original texture · Graphics and controller test
Swap A/B and X/Y (alternate controller layout)

Controls as on the GameCube: A, B, X, Y by their labels · left stick: control stick · right stick: C stick · D-pad · START · R2: R (ready weapon) · L2: L (knife) · R1: Z (map) · SELECT: menu (graphics, memory card, error log) · hold SELECT: the game\'s debug menu
Requires your own game discs. Not affiliated with Capcom.
Select ISO/GCM files of the November 25, 2004 debug build
Swap A/B and X/Y (when the buttons do not act as labeled)
Connect a controller and press a button.

A/Cross: Action · B/Circle: Run/Back · X/Square: Reload · Y/Triangle: Inventory\nLT/L2: Aim · RT/R2: Fire/Knife attack · LB/L1: Hold knife · Start/Options: Pause\nPress A/Cross when the kick prompt appears. The arrow/Android Back opens the menu. The texture test has no gameplay.

This test decodes r100 from Disc 1 and r300 from Disc 2, compares the results with the original PowerPC decoder, and validates archive file tables. It also checks SMD placements, local BIN vertex limits, GX primitives and attribute indices. Rigid 3D previews of r100 and r300 use original base textures. Select a room from the complete disc catalog to load its supported rigid geometry. No gameplay.
Room texture r100 · Graphics and controller test

Left stick/D-pad: Forward/back, turn left/right · Hold B/Circle: Run
Back + B/Circle: Quick turn · A/Cross: Action/Window jump · Start: In-game menu · View/Select: Map
Hold LT/L2: Raise weapon · Right stick: Aim · RT/R2: Fire · X/Square: Reload
Release LT/L2: Lower weapon · Right stick otherwise: Camera · Y/Triangle: Case · View/Select: Map
Ganado test: r400 with handgun and melee. While grabbed, move the left stick rapidly left/right or repeatedly press A/Cross and B/Circle.
Leon has infinite health; hit reactions and breaking free remain active. A/Cross starts the displayed ladder/jump action and picks up items. Destroy crates and barrels with the handgun or knife. Red barrels explode, damaging enemies and triggering chain reactions. Herbs are kept when health is full. Select Equip in the case to choose weapons. r101 has sky, fog, fire, smoke and original audio. Full scenario AI is in development. Use the model inspector button; LT/RT adjusts camera distance there.
